<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex040012026-09-1004-05-33" status="unreviewed">so so'i <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> la na las drod ni so bo rang gis zhes pa laso pa ste | 'di la
            na ste || dmigs pa dang | rnaM pa dang | ngo dang | grogs so || dmigs pa ni so so ba gis
            bden pa dngos la zhes pa ste | gzhan gyis ma bstan mangs nyid gyis bsgos pa'i stobs kyis
            || yang na rang gi rgyud kyis bsdus ba'i bden pa rnaMs la zhes bya ba'o || <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="198a9"/> zhes <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3921">tho</rs> zer te | rang gis zhes 'byung bas lnga ma nyid khegs zhes gsung ngo ||</seg></TEI>
